verdict.rationale: Cognee documents sessions as per-user short-term memory holding an ordered list of recent interactions, and `improve()` can bridge session memory into permanent memory at the end of an agent session. Together these let an agent recall prior session context, but nothing documents generating summaries of past sessions or threads. Missing for 10: explicit session/thread summarization, a documented flow for resuming a prior conversation from a summary, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off

citations.quote: A session is Cognee's short-term memory for a specific user. It is identified by `(user_id, session_id)` and stores an ordered list of recent interactions.
Use it at the end of a chat or agent session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory.
cognee.remember(data, session_id="my_session") — writes content directly into the session cache for fast retrieval.
